strategy: Immutable event key (time, phase, absolute STD only for EV_TRY when enabled, original serial). Same-time currently queued attempts only.
first_population: Nanning 1x original window98259; root dispatch only; 2x deferred
invariants: canonical FIFO and EBS actual-completion gate unchanged
no added internal waiting or future task knowledge
limitations: Phase3 activation may enqueue a source attempt after earlier phase2 already executed; no retroactive reorder
Serial source planning arbitration, not distributed node bidding
EDF can harm feasible jobs when an already-overdue FIFO head wins
THT/preplanning/throughput/STD all required; no net-win guaranteed
